from pathlib import Path

def check_memory_health(base_path, label):
    files = {
        'common-errors.md': base_path / 'common-errors.md',
        'lessons-learned.md': base_path / 'lessons-learned.md',
        'session-history.md': base_path / 'session-history.md'
    }
    
    print(f'\n{label}:')
    total_size = 0
    for name, path in files.items():
        if path.exists():
            size = path.stat().st_size
            total_size += size
            capacity_pct = (size / 8192) * 100
            status = '✓' if capacity_pct < 85 else '⚠' if capacity_pct < 100 else '✗'
            print(f'  {name}: {size:,} bytes ({capacity_pct:.1f}%) {status}')
    
    tier_capacity_pct = (total_size / 24576) * 100
    tier_status = '✓ OPTIMAL' if tier_capacity_pct < 85 else '⚠ APPROACHING LIMIT' if tier_capacity_pct < 100 else '✗ OVER LIMIT'
    print(f'  Total: {total_size:,} bytes ({tier_capacity_pct:.1f}%) {tier_status}')
    return total_size

# Global memory
global_size = check_memory_health(Path('/Users/rmuller/.claude/memory'), 'Global Memory')

# Project memory
project_files = {
    'current-session.md': Path('/Users/rmuller/dev/nac-nd-gui/.claude/memory/project/current-session.md'),
    'project-errors.md': Path('/Users/rmuller/dev/nac-nd-gui/.claude/memory/project/project-errors.md'),
    'project-lessons.md': Path('/Users/rmuller/dev/nac-nd-gui/.claude/memory/project/project-lessons.md')
}

print('\nProject Memory:')

for name, path in project_files.items():
    if path.exists():
        size = path.stat().st_size
        project_size += size
        capacity_pct = (size / 8192) * 100
        status = '✓' if capacity_pct < 85 else '⚠' if capacity_pct < 100 else '✗'
        print(f'  {name}: {size:,} bytes ({capacity_pct:.1f}%) {status}')

project_capacity_pct = (project_size / 24576) * 100
project_status = '✓ OPTIMAL' if project_capacity_pct < 85 else '⚠ APPROACHING LIMIT' if project_capacity_pct < 100 else '✗ OVER LIMIT'
print(f'  Total: {project_size:,} bytes ({project_capacity_pct:.1f}%) {project_status}')

# Combined system
